nodes.name: NF pretreatment
nodes.procedure: NF (4.0 cm×1.5 cm×0.17 cm) was pretreated in 1M H₂SO₄ absolute ethanol, and DI for 15 min under ultrasonication to clean surface impurities.

nodes.name: Co(OH)F/NF hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 4 mmol of Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O, 20 mmol of CO(NH₂)₂, and 16 mmol of NH₄F were dissolved in 70 mL of DI to form a clear aqueous solution, which was then transferred to a 100 mL Teflon-lined stainless steel autoclave with a piece of cleaned NF immersed into the aqueous solution. Afterward, the autoclave was sealed and heated at 120°C for 8 h before naturally cooling to room temperature. The sample was picked out and rinsed with DI several times.

nodes.name: NH₂-Co-MOF/NF hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 5 mmol of NH₂BDC was dissolved in a mixed solution (50 mL DMF, 5 mL absolute ethanol, and 5 mL DI) under magnetic stirring to obtain a homogeneous solution. Next, the homogeneous solution was transferred to a 100 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave reactor with a piece of tilted Co(OH)F/NF. After the reactor was sealed, it was transferred to a blast drying oven to heat to 160°C and then maintained for 8 h to obtain NH₂-Co-MOF/NF before naturally cooling down to room temperature. The sample was washed alternately with absolute ethanol and DI several times to remove residual organic ligands. Finally, the NH₂-Co-MOF/NF was dried at 60°C for 6 h.
nodes.source_text: 5 mmol of NH₂BDC was dissolved in a mixed solution (50 mL DMF, 5 mL absolute ethanol, and 5 mL DI)... dried at 60°C for 6 h.

nodes.name: CoO@NC/NF carbonization
nodes.procedure: The NH₂-Co-MOF/NF sample was carbonized in a tube furnace at 400°C at a ramp rate of 5°C min⁻¹ and maintained for 3 h under N₂ atmosphere to get CoO@NC/NF.
nodes.source_text: The NH₂-Co-MOF/NF sample was carbonized in a tube furnace at 400°C at a ramp rate of 5°C min⁻¹ and maintained for 3 h under N₂ atmosphere

nodes.name: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC sulfidation
nodes.procedure: 12 mmol of C₂H₅NS was dissolved in 60 mL ethanol under magnetic stirring for 15 min to obtain a homogeneous solution. The solution was transferred to a 100 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave reactor and a piece of CoO@NC/NF. The reactor was sealed and maintained at 160°C for 3 h before naturally cooling to room temperature. The obtained Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC was thoroughly rinsed with ethanol and DI and then dried at 60°C overnight.
nodes.source_text: 12 mmol of C₂H₅NS was dissolved in 60 mL ethanol... dried at 60°C overnight.

nodes.name: Co(OH)F-10%Mo/NF hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: Same procedure as Co(OH)F/NF synthesis (4 mmol Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O, 20 mmol CO(NH₂)₂, 16 mmol NH₄F in 70 mL DI, hydrothermal at 120°C for 8 h), except 10% mole ratio Na₂MoO₄·2H₂O to Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O added. Sample rinsed with DI several times.

unit_operations.name: Solution preparation with Mo
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Same as step 2 except 10% mole ratio Na₂MoO₄·2H₂O to Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O added

nodes.source_text: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂ - X%Mo@NC was obtained following the same procedure of Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC, except that different mole ratio of Na₂MoO₄·2H₂O to Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O (0, 2%, 10%, and 18%) was added during the hydrothermal growth of Co(OH)F.

nodes.name: NH₂-Co-MOF-10%Mo/NF synthesis
nodes.procedure: Same procedure as NH₂-Co-MOF/NF using Co(OH)F-10%Mo/NF as precursor with 5 mmol NH₂BDC in 50 mL DMF + 5 mL ethanol + 5 mL DI, hydrothermal at 160°C for 8 h, washed with ethanol/DI, dried at 60°C for 6 h.
nodes.source_text: To enable the subsequent growth of metal sulfides... NH₂-Co-MOF/NF nanosheet was synthesized by selecting Co(OH)F as a precursor and NH₂BDC as an organic linker.

nodes.name: CoO@NC-10%Mo/NF carbonization
nodes.procedure: NH₂-Co-MOF-10%Mo/NF carbonized at 400°C ramp 5°C/min for 3 h under N₂ to get CoO@NC-10%Mo/NF.
nodes.source_text: NH₂-Co-MOF was then heated to 400°C and maintained in a nitrogen-protected atmosphere for 3 h to obtain CoO@NC - x%Mo / NF.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC shows typical diffraction peaks for both cubic Co₃S₄ (PDF#75-1561) at 31.4°, 38.2°, 50.6°, 55.3° and rhombohedral Ni₃S₂ (PDF#85-1802) at 21.7° (010) plane.
nodes.evidence_snippet: After the addition of MoO₄²⁻, the Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC had typical diffraction peaks for both Co₃S₄ and Ni₃S₂ while the peaks at 31.4°, 38.2°, 50.6°, 55.3° can be assigned to cubic Co₃S₄ (PDF#75-1561), and 21.7° can be assigned to (010) plane of rhombohedral Ni₃S₂ (PDF#85-1802).

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC shows Co-S characteristic peaks redshifted at 530 and 457 cm⁻¹ due to long Co-S bond length indicating lattice expansion of Co₃S₄, Ni-S at 314 and 217 cm⁻¹, I_D/I_G = 1.89.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In contrast, the Co-S characteristic peak redshift of Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC nanomaterials is due to the long bond length of the Co-S bond, which indicates that the etching-redeposition strategy at a medium temperature-short time can trigger the lattice expansion of Co₃S₄.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC shows metal sulfide nanocrystals ~6 nm on N-doped carbon, SAED confirms polycrystalline Co₃S₄ (400) and Ni₃S₂ (020) phases.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Metal sulfide clusters with a diameter of about 6 nm can be observed uniformly dispersed on the N-doped carbon nanosheet substrate. The selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern taken from a large area indicates the polycrystalline structure with ring patterns identified as (020) face of Ni₃S₂ and (400) face of Co₃S₄.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC shows (400) plane expanded to 0.239 nm (1.7% larger than standard), lattice distortion, and stacking faults with 0.29 nm gaps.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The (400) crystal plane spacing of Co₃S₄ expands to 0.239 nm, 1.7% larger than that of the standard PDF card. And the expansion or fault layer with a gap of 0.29 nm appears between the units every two layers.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC confirms lattice distortion and stacking faults via GPA showing tensile strain along xy direction and mixed strains along yy.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The tensile strain was mainly along the xy direction, while the tensile and compressive strains existed along the yy direction, and the strains were distributed along dislocations.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC shows Co 2p₃/₂ at 780.8 eV (Co³⁺) and 782.3 eV (Co²⁺) with red shift vs Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC, Ni 2p at 855.7 eV (Ni²⁺) and 857.3 eV (Ni³⁺) with blue shift, S 2p M-S at 168.5 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC, the peaks at 780.8 eV corresponds to Co³⁺, and the peaks at 782.3 eV can be assigned to Co²⁺. Ni 2p narrow scan showed Ni²⁺ peak at 855.7 eV, and Ni³⁺ peak at 857.3±0.1 eV.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC shows type IV adsorption-desorption isotherm with H₃ hysteresis loop and Brunauer-Emmett-Teller surface area of 4.0 m²/g (vs 2.3 m²/g for Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The adsorption and desorption curves of the Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC and Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC were all type IV with an H₃ type hysteresis. The specific surface area of the Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC was 4.0±3.1% m²/g, large than that of Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC (2.3±5.4% m²/g).

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC double-layer capacitance C_dl = 104.3±0.1 mF/cm² (vs 28.6±0.2 mF/cm² for Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC) measured at scan rates 20-100 mV/s in non-Faradaic region.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The ECSA of Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC (104.3±0.1 mF/cm²) was greater than that of Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC (28.6±0.2 mF/cm²).

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC shows lowest charge transfer resistance R_ct = 6.4±0.1 Ω.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Nyquist plots show the Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC (Rct = 6.4±0.1Ω) had a minor charge transfer resistance than Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC (Rct = 31.8±0.7Ω).

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC shows work function of 3.09 eV and valence band maximum at 2.73 eV, valence band center ε_v at 9.57 eV vs Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC at 3.15 eV, 2.07 eV, 9.47 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The work function values of Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC and Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC were 3.09 eV and 3.15 eV. Valence band spectra showed a valence band maximum (VBM) energy at 2.73 and 2.07 eV. The ε_v values were 9.57 and 9.47 eV.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC shows formation of CoOOH peaks at 460 cm⁻¹ and 560 cm⁻¹ under OER conditions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: With the gradual increase of the applied voltage, two new peaks appeared at 460 cm⁻¹ and 560 cm⁻¹, indicating the production of CoOOH.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC shows uniform distribution of all elements with rare Mo detection.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The energy dispersive spectrum (EDS) of Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC/NF shows all elements to be uniformly distributed throughout the catalyst crystal. It is worth noting that Mo elements were rarely detected.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC maintains uniform nanosheet structure assembled into smaller, more uniformly arranged nanospheres vs Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂@NC (Fig. 1c, d) and Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC (Fig. 1f-h) obtained by hydrothermal sulfidation maintained the uniform arrangement of the nanosheet structure to a certain extent, and although they all appeared to be assembled into nanospheres, it can be clearly observed that the nanospheres of Co₃S₄/Ni₃S₂-10%Mo@NC were more uniformly arranged and had a smaller unit volume.
